# ko lexicon — authoring review sheet (generated by content/ko/_drafts/_generators/ko-lex.py)

Hand-chosen lexicon for ko-vi: 783 A1 words and 212 A2-1 words (core-*.txt). It replaces the pool-only sheet of `scripts/lexicon-author.ts`; do not re-run that script over it. Staged until promote.

A human still has to check:

- **Vietnamese text.** Every gloss and example translation was written by an AI agent and awaits the D-10 review. There are no `TODO:vi` markers.
- **Korean examples.** Original sentences in 해요체 (합쇼체 only where the word itself is, such as 감사합니다), checked by ko-lex.py for length and for using the word only — a native or advanced reader should read every one.
- **English glosses.** Short glosses for the build tools; the ko-en words keep the pack's own glosses (`the man`, `to eat`).

## Counts

- A1 by part of speech: adjective 81, adverb 65, determiner 9, expression 34, interjection 5, noun 426, other 35, pronoun 17, verb 111
- Topics (A1 + A2-1): animals 13, body 53, clothing 15, colors 12, everyday 153, family 24, feelings 34, food 64, greetings 28, home 57, leisure 32, nature 9, numbers 39, people 36, places 59, school 35, shopping 29, technology 14, time 82, travel 47, weather 14, work 146
- Readings (RR): 474 keep the reading P4b confirmed against Wiktionary; 521 are the rule output of `scripts/lib/cjk-readings/korean-rr.ts` (words outside the pool, set phrases). 6 disagree with the pool's Wiktionary romanization and are listed below.
- Frequency (FrequencyWords, through the candidate pool): 468 of 995; 480 lexemes match a pool lemma (kaikki-en refs).
- Examples: 995, all original (`original-lexicon-etl`, key `add`), with Vietnamese and English translations; no Tatoeba sentence is used.
- Hán-Việt: 194 course words added to `content/hanviet/ko.json` (231 entries with the P4b ones); 226 lexemes have a reading there. Sino-Korean words with hanja only, never a native word; false friends carry a note.
- ko-en (basic pack, never edited): every word maps to a lexeme with the pack's English gloss.

## Frequency anchor

No allowlisted Korean learner list can be fetched (the NIKL 한국어 학습용 어휘 목록 is owner-download only, OWNER-FINAL-CHECKLIST C). The anchor is the 300 most frequent content entries of the candidate pool (FrequencyWords counts over kaikki lemmas): 182 are taken (30 of them as the same word under the course's part of speech, such as 오늘 noun for the pool's adverb entry); the 118 left out are listed by reason. The pool counts subtitle word forms, so many of its top entries are inflected forms or rare homographs that took a common form's count.

**Beyond the A1 and A2-1 bands of this course (TOPIK I level 2 tail or TOPIK II); kept for later bands** (43): 만약/adverb, 자기/noun, 왜냐하면/adverb, 이상/noun, 아직도/adverb, 그저/adverb, 가장/adverb, 한번/adverb, 제대로/adverb, 그렇지만/adverb, 완전히/adverb, 정말로/adverb, 부인/noun, 아마도/adverb, 완전/adverb, 완전/noun, 어쨌든/adverb, 신경/noun, 이리/adverb, 그때/noun, 당장/adverb, 얼른/adverb, 평생/noun, 분명/adverb, 영원히/adverb, 정신/noun, 그대로/adverb, 한번/noun, 대체/adverb, 만큼/noun, 번째/noun, 단지/adverb, 마이크/noun, 가만히/adverb, 또한/adverb, 굉장히/adverb, 절대로/adverb, 마음대로/adverb, 심지어/adverb, 사건/noun, 상관/noun, 만날/adverb, 마구/adverb

## RR rule output vs Wiktionary

The reading shipped is the rule output; check each against the official rule text.

- 깨끗하다 (adjective): rule "kkaekkeutada" vs Wiktionary "kkaekkeuthada"
- 착하다 (adjective): rule "chakada" vs Wiktionary "chakhada"
- 비슷하다 (adjective): rule "biseutada" vs Wiktionary "biseuthada"
- 특히 (adverb): rule "teuki" vs Wiktionary "teukhi"
- 솔직히 (adverb): rule "soljiki" vs Wiktionary "soljikhi"
- 정확히 (adverb): rule "jeonghwaki" vs Wiktionary "jeonghwakhi"
